call.hello.hello_again.note: Uses 'mi sente' (Lei form) as the second hello.

call.speech.im_here.back: Yes, I'm here, I can hear you. Please, go ahead.

call.speech.still_there.back: Hello? Are you still on the line?

call.speech.bye.note: English is just 'Bye'; Arrivederci is a bit formal.

call.speech.think_about_it.back: I'd have to think about it.

call.speech.wait_one_more.back: Ah, wait, I still have one more question.

call.speech.no_wait.back: "one moment", "a moment", "let me check" (informal), "let me check" (polite), "wait a second" (informal), "wait a moment" (polite)
call.speech.no_wait.note: fixed: now only a quoted comma-separated list of phrases, with the Lei forms added (mi faccia controllare, aspetti un attimo). Earlier note: the banned stalling phrases were given only in the informal tu form.

call.speech.unavailable.back: The number you have called is not reachable at the moment. Please try again later.
call.speech.unavailable.note: Formal 'Lei' announcement wording; check it sounds like a real carrier message.

call.speech.preview.back: Hello? / Ah, a package? Of course, just leave it in front of the door, thank you very much. / All right, goodbye.

call.speech.closing.back: Farewells: goodbye, goodbye (formal), have a good day, have a good evening, see you soon, we'll talk, see you later. Wrap-ups: that's all for now, I won't keep you, I'll call you back later, I'm hanging up now. Ends: Thank you very much, goodbye. / That's fine, have a good day. / Perfect, we'll talk tomorrow, see you soon. Not ends: Good morning, this is Marco from the bank. / I have a good work day ahead of me, but first let me explain the offer to you. / The course is called "See you soon" and costs one hundred euros a month.
call.speech.closing.note: Words come from closing.rs; examples not machine-verified.

notify.ap_already.back: This appointment has already been handled

notify.ap_replaced.back: The time changed during the call; "{}" is still in your calendar. Delete it yourself.

notify.ap_sales_voided.back: Call judged to be a sales call, so the appointment made during the call was cancelled: {}

notify.ap_sms.note: Row label; the web console option name for texting the caller is a guess, check against the Italian console text.

notify.ap_sms_busy.back: the same SMS is already being sent

notify.ap_sms_cannot.back: an SMS can't be sent to this number, call them back yourself

notify.ap_sms_no.back: I'm sorry, {} unfortunately doesn't suit me anymore. Can we find another time?
notify.ap_sms_no.note: {} is a weekday plus numeric date and time; check that the sentence reads well with that.

notify.ap_sms_off.back: will not be sent (the "SMS to the caller" option is turned off in Settings)
notify.ap_sms_off.note: Quotes an option name ("Text the caller"); must match the Italian console label, which is not known yet.

notify.ap_sms_ok.back: {} works for me. See you soon!
notify.ap_sms_ok.note: {} is a weekday plus numeric date and time; check that the sentence reads well with that.

notify.ap_sms_old_app.back: the app on the phone is too old to send SMS

notify.ap_sms_timeout.back: the phone did not respond (timed out)

notify.ap_sms_will.back: will be sent when you tap Accept or Decline

notify.ap_time_unconfirmed.back: The caller did not confirm the time repeated by the AI; check it with that person before replying

notify.ap_void_failed.back: "{}" from the call was cancelled but it couldn't be removed from the calendar. Delete it yourself.

notify.bl_announced_hint.back: blacklisted number: the notice was played and then the call was ended (without AI)

notify.bl_declined_hint.back: blacklisted number: rejected while ringing (without AI)

notify.bl_declined_reply.back: rejected while ringing: no answer (without AI)

notify.cw_end_hint.back: call waiting: the phone was already on another call and rejected it (without AI)

notify.cw_matter.back: Came in during another call; the phone rejected it because it was busy{sim}

notify.f_callback_no_number.back: No number to call back: the task has no contact and the caller's number is empty.

notify.f_callback_waiting.back: The callback is scheduled, but the phone's control connection is not online. Make sure the phone is connected to Bageo, then confirm again.

notify.f_callback_whitelist.back: The number to call back is not on the whitelist. Add it (or a prefix ending with *) in Settings, then confirm again.

notify.f_email_no_address.back: This task sends an email but has no reply address. Add the contact from the transcript or ignore the task.

notify.f_gmail_missing.back: Gmail is not configured. Enter the Gmail address and the app password in Settings, then confirm again.

notify.f_openclaw_failed.back: Unable to pass the task on to OpenClaw: {} (check the OpenClaw address and token in Settings)

notify.g_bad_address.back: The Gmail address doesn't look right. Check it in Settings.

notify.g_bad_recipient.back: Not sent: the recipient's address doesn't look right

notify.g_no_recipient.back: Not sent: the recipient's address is missing

notify.g_short_password.back: The Gmail app password is too short. Enter it again in Settings (it is never shown).

notify.h_ai_ended.back: the AI answered and spoke; the call ended normally (the AI said goodbye and hung up, or the caller hung up first)

notify.h_ai_fail_hangup.back: the AI couldn't connect; the system hung up and the caller heard nothing

notify.h_ai_fail_voicemail.back: the AI didn't work; the call went to voicemail

notify.h_reject_hidden.back: hidden number: the rejection notice was played and then the call was ended (the AI did not answer)

notify.h_reject_list.back: blacklisted number: the notice that the number is unavailable was played and then the call was ended (the AI did not answer)

notify.h_scam_stalling_off.back: the system judged it a sales / scam call ({t}); the option to waste their time is turned off, so the AI answered as usual
notify.h_scam_stalling_off.note: Stalling is described as 'far perdere tempo'; the console label for this option may differ.

notify.h_stall_released.back: the system at first took it for a sales / scam call; a second check found a normal call and the AI went back to talking as usual

notify.h_stall_spam.back: the system judged it a sales / scam call ({t}), so the AI deliberately kept the caller on the line to waste their time

notify.h_stall_spam_nokind.back: the system judged it a sales / scam call, so the AI deliberately kept the caller on the line to waste their time

notify.h_urgent_failed.back: the caller said it was urgent: the phone called the owner but got no answer, and the AI told the caller the owner will call back soon; this call was not treated as a sales or scam call to keep on the line, so under "To do" write to call back as soon as possible
notify.h_urgent_failed.note: Names the to-do label «Da fare»; must stay equal to notify.s_todo.

notify.h_urgent_merged.back: the caller said it was urgent: the phone called the owner, who answered and was put through to the caller, and the AI left the call; this call was not treated as a sales or scam call to keep on the line

notify.h_urgent_transfer.back: the caller said it was urgent and the owner was alerted right away; this call was not treated as a sales or scam call to keep on the line, so under "To do" write to call back as soon as possible
notify.h_urgent_transfer.note: Names the to-do label «Da fare»; must stay equal to notify.s_todo.

notify.n_blocked_declined.back: Rejected while ringing: no answer, without AI

notify.n_blocked_done.back: Played "{}" and ended the call. The AI was not used.

notify.n_fit_adjusted.back: Bageo adjusted the call audio by itself. Now it works.

notify.n_fit_problem.back: Call audio has a problem and all settings were tried. See “First use on a new phone” in the guide.

notify.n_fit_test_body.back: This phone has not been tested yet. Call it from another phone and talk to the AI for about 20 seconds. Then Bageo adjusts the call audio by itself.

notify.n_fit_test_title.back: New phone: try the call audio

notify.n_fit_unsupported.back: This phone cannot send the AI's voice into calls.

notify.n_repeat_body.back: Other calls from {number} in the last minute: {count}. They were not sent one by one.

notify.n_repeat_title.back: Repeated calls from the same number

notify.n_test_body.back: This is a test notification from Bageo. If you can read it, the notification channel works.

notify.s_ai_fail_matter.back: The AI didn't connect; the system hung up after about {} and the caller heard nothing

notify.s_ai_fail_prefix.back: [The AI didn't connect; the system hung up]
notify.s_ai_fail_prefix.note: Square brackets kept because the English text has them; the checker allows them only for that reason.

notify.s_ai_failed.back: The AI didn't connect and said nothing

notify.s_call_back_if_known.back: Call back if you know the number

notify.s_caller.note: English label 'Caller'; chose Chiamante like d_caller, though 'Chi' could read more naturally in a summary.

notify.s_listen_recording.back: Listen to the recording in the web console

notify.s_no_summary.back: (No summary: see the transcript in the web console.)

notify.s_no_transcript.back: The call lasted about {}; there is no usable transcript

notify.s_see_transcript.back: See the transcript in the web console

notify.s_stall_reply.back: Kept the caller on the line for about {}; gave no data and accepted nothing

notify.vm_call_back_unchecked.back: Asks for a callback (number not checked)

notify.vm_call_back_unknown.back: Asks for a callback to this number (confirmed with 1, but the number is not known)

notify.vm_email_to.back: Asks for a reply by email: {} (confirmed with 1)

notify.vm_email_unknown.back: Asks for a reply by email (confirmed with 1, but the address is not known)

notify.vm_no_choice.back: No reply method chosen (the call ended earlier)

notify.vm_no_transcript.back: A message of about {}; it couldn't be transcribed. Listen to the recording

notify.vm_task_failed.back: Voicemail message (not transcribable; to be checked)

notify.ap_weekdays.back: Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun

notify.ap_dt_fmt.note: Numeric date with 'ore' before the time; chrono cannot write Italian month names.

notify.date_fmt.note: Numeric day/month because chrono writes month names in English only.

notify.dt_fmt.note: Numeric day/month because chrono writes month names in English only.

desktop.adb_failed.back: Download failed. Check your connection and try again.

desktop.adb_need.back: Phones via USB require the Android tools (about 7 MB, from Google).

desktop.err_addr.back: The address must start with http:// or https://.

desktop.err_save.back: Some settings were not saved. Try again.

desktop.locked.back: Enter the password to see your phones.

desktop.no_phone_hint.back: Connect a phone and open the app. It will appear here.

desktop.open.note: English 'Open console' written with the full term web console

desktop.r_launch_failed.back: Bageo did not start. Look at bageo.log in its folder.

desktop.r_offline.back: Bageo cannot be reached. Is it still running?

desktop.set_addr_hint.back: Leave empty to find it automatically.

desktop.set_notify_sms_old.back: Update Bageo and the SMS forwarding to receive these notifications.
desktop.set_notify_sms_old.note: 'SMS forwarder' is a separate component name

desktop.set_notify_summary.back: When a call's summary is ready

desktop.set_pw_hint.back: Only needed if your console has a password.

console.theme_toggle.back: Switch between light and dark theme

console.copy_failed.back: Unable to copy. Select the text and copy it manually.

console.err_network.back: Unable to reach Bageo. Is it still running?

console.setup_title.back: Welcome! Three steps and the phone answers on its own

console.setup_1_d.back: Add your Gemini API key and your name.

console.setup_2_d.back: Connect the phone with the installed app via USB and wait until it displays 'Ready for calls'. Afterwards you can unplug it: it switches to Wi-Fi on its own.

console.setup_3_d.back: Pick where to send call summaries, e.g. Telegram or Discord.

console.empty_body.back: Connect your phone and call its number. The call will appear here with its summary and recording.

console.d_pending.back: Writing summary… takes about half a minute after the call.

console.d_live.back: Call is still ongoing. Summary and conversation will appear when it ends.

console.d_src_fallback.back: The summary service didn't reply, so this is just a provisional note.

console.ap_time_unconfirmed.back: The caller didn't confirm the time repeated by the AI; check it with this person before replying

console.ap_working.back: Processing… (up to 90 seconds if an SMS is sent)

console.sms_c_busy.back: that same SMS is already being sent

console.sms_c_no_permission.back: app lacks permission to send SMS

console.sms_c_radio_off.back: phone's mobile network is off (airplane mode)

console.sms_c_sim_not_found.back: selected SIM card isn't in the phone

console.cal_pick_title.back: Which calendar do you want to add it to?

console.cal_hint_office365.back: Outlook with work or school account

console.cal_hint_apple.back: iPhone, iPad, Mac: open it and tap Add

console.cal_hint_ics.back: Any other calendar app: import file

console.ap_res_yes_sent.back: Accepted, and an SMS was sent to the caller

console.ap_res_no_sent.back: Declined, and an SMS was sent to the caller

console.ap_res_sms_none.back: This number doesn't receive SMS; call it back yourself

console.ap_res_hidden.back: Hidden number: unable to notify caller

console.ap_call_failed.back: Unable to place the AI callback

console.ap_call_no_phone.back: No callback: no phone connected to call

console.ap_call_send_failed.back: No callback: the phone did not receive the request

console.ap_call_no_number.back: Hidden number: unable to call back

console.ap_call_queued.back: AI will call as soon as the previous callback to the same number ends

console.ap_call_answered.back: AI callback succeeded and the caller was notified

console.ap_call_not_callable.back: No callback: this number cannot be called back (foreign, toll-free, premium, or short)

console.tr_listen_h.back: Entire call: caller and AI together.

console.tr_vm_h.back: Only the message left by the caller.

console.end_ai_fail.back: The AI could not connect, so the call was hung up.

console.end_voicemail.back: The AI didn't work and the call went to voicemail.

console.end_hidden.back: Hidden number: a rejection announcement played and the call ended. The AI didn't answer.

console.end_blocked.back: Blacklisted number: the "unavailable" announcement played and the call ended. The AI didn't answer.

console.end_spam.back: Judged a sales or scam call, so the AI kept the caller on the line to waste their time.

console.end_normal.back: The AI answered and spoke, and the call ended normally.

console.end_call_waiting.back: Arrived during another call and the phone rejected it as busy (no AI).

console.d_block_body.back: Calls from this number will be rejected. The AI won't answer.

console.d_notfound.back: This call wasn't found. It may be older than the recording retention period.

console.ev_gemini_unmute_after_greet.back: The AI picked up the call

console.d_scam_none.back: Not judged as sales or scam

console.d_scam_released.back: Initially judged sales or scam, then treated as a normal call

console.d_fb_q.back: Was that right? Your answer will be used for future calls from this number.

console.d_fb_done.back: Noted. Future calls from this number will be rated this way.

console.f_scam_blind.back: Check each call for sales and scams

console.f_scam_blind_h.back: On: catches new tricks as well, using slightly more quota. Off: checks only calls with typical sales or scam words.

console.ct_empty_body.back: Add people manually or import contacts from your phone, Google, or Outlook. When they call you see their name and the AI knows who they are.

console.ct_note_help.back: The AI sees it when they call, e.g. "my sister", "landlord", "colleague".

console.ct_delete_body.back: Calls from these numbers will show just the number again.

console.ct_need_phone.back: Enter at least one phone number.

console.ct_exists.back: This number is already saved under {name}.

console.ct_imp_drop.back: Drag a file here or click to pick one

console.ct_imp_formats.back: vCard, CSV, Excel, Word, and text files work. PDFs and images are read by Gemini, requiring a Gemini API key. Max 10 MB.

console.ct_imp_skipped.back: {n} entries missing a name or number were omitted.

console.ct_imp_none.back: In this file no contacts with a phone number were found.

console.ct_imp_by_ai.back: Gemini read this file: verify names and numbers before importing.

console.err_contact_exists.back: This number is already saved under another contact.

console.err_invalid_contact.back: Enter a name and at least one phone number.

console.err_too_many_contacts.back: At most 10,000 contacts can be saved.

console.err_contacts_save_failed.back: Unable to save contacts to disk.

console.err_need_gemini_key.back: This file type is read by Gemini: add the Gemini API key in Settings first.

console.err_unsupported_file.back: This file type can't be read. Save it as .xlsx, .csv, .vcf, or PDF and retry.

console.err_too_many_rows.back: This file is too large (max 100,000 rows). Split it or keep only contact columns.

console.s_meta.back: Changes take effect from the next call.

console.saved.back: Saved. Effective from the next call.

console.notify_follows_ui.back: Now notifications are in {lang} as well (settings: Notification language).

console.g_basics_d.back: The few things the AI needs before answering the phone.

console.f_language_h.back: The language the AI speaks with whoever calls.

console.f_notify_lang_h.back: The language of the notifications and summaries that you read. Doesn't change the language the AI speaks with callers.

console.f_simlang_h.back: Calls to this SIM start in the main language; a call from abroad uses the second language set for its region, else its country's language. Needs the phone app 1.0 or newer.

console.sl_lang_sim.back: The language of the SIM region

console.sl_empty.back: Nothing set: every call begins in the language chosen above.

console.f_owner_h.back: The name callers call you by. The AI uses it when talking about you.

console.f_owner_aliases_h.back: A nickname, a foreign name, and so on. One per line, max 10. The AI understands they're looking for you.

console.style_assistant_d.back: States that it's your AI assistant and takes a message.

console.style_persona_d.back: Replies as though it were you, without making commitments on your behalf.

console.f_key_link.back: Get a key on Google AI Studio

console.f_model_h.back: The model the AI speaks with. Rarely needs changing.

console.f_voice_h.back: The preview plays three sample phrases in the language selected above.

console.f_enabled_h.back: Off: calls are answered and hung up right away. To let the phone ring normally, use "Switch to normal phone" on the System page or in the phone app.

console.f_ring_h.back: Rings a bit before answering, as a person would. 0 = right away.

console.f_normal_max_h.back: From 3 to 30. Shortly before the limit, the AI says goodbye politely and hangs up.

console.f_prewarm.back: Prepare the AI while the phone rings

console.f_prewarm_h.back: Recommended: the AI speaks as soon as it answers. Off: the caller waits 1 to 3 seconds.

console.f_unknown_h.back: On: callers with no visible number talk to the AI like everyone else. Off: they hear a brief 'not available' notice and the call ends.

console.f_barge_h.back: The AI pauses and listens when the caller speaks over it. Not all phones support this; Bageo checks on its own.

console.f_vad.back: Let Gemini decide when the caller finishes speaking

console.f_vad_h.back: Recommended. Off: decides based only on voice volume.

console.f_reply_lang_h.back: The AI switches only when the caller clearly speaks another language in full sentences; a quick hello or unclear words do not count.

console.f_status_h.back: A note on the current moment, e.g. where a courier should leave a parcel. The AI mentions it only if relevant to the call.

console.f_status_ph.back: e.g. Deliveries: feel free to leave the parcel at reception.

console.f_amb_h.back: Adds subtle ambient noise behind the AI's voice so it sounds like a real person.

console.g_spam_d.back: What the AI does when a caller clearly wants to sell something or attempt a scam.

console.f_stall_h.back: The AI feigns interest and keeps asking for details to waste time. It gives no data and accepts nothing. Off: declines and hangs up.

console.f_stall_max_h.back: From 3 to 30. Longer calls consume more Gemini quota.

console.f_stall_model_h.back: Empty = same model as normal calls.

console.g_prompt_d.back: A few short answers help the AI speak like you. Everything is optional.

console.f_prompt_ph.back: Empty: the default prompt is used

console.f_prompt_h.back: If filled in, replaces conversation style and local habits. Each answer style keeps its own; write {owner} for your name.

console.p_builtin_h.back: For your saved language, answer style, and name. If you just modified them, save first.

console.p_replace_body.back: The editor already contains text. It will be replaced with the default prompt.

console.f_knowledge.back: Info the AI can answer with

console.f_knowledge_ph.back: e.g. Parcels: leave them with the concierge. Opening hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 to 18:00.

console.f_knowledge_h.back: Info callers might ask for, one per line. The AI must not make up anything not written here.

console.g_blocked_d.back: Played when a call from the blacklist or a hidden number is rejected. Manage the blacklist in 'Contacts'.

console.b_help.back: End a number with * to blacklist all numbers starting the same way, e.g. 0800* (at least 3 digits, excluding leading zeros).

console.reject_decline.back: Hang up while ringing (call doesn't connect)

console.reject_announce.back: Answer, play the 'not available' notice, and hang up

console.f_reject_voice_h.back: The announcement is spoken in the language selected above.

console.g_notify_d.back: Receive a message when a call arrives and the summary when it finishes.

console.f_notify_on_h.back: Off: sends nothing to any notification channel.

console.n_empty.back: No notification channels. Add one to receive summaries on your phone.

console.n_ctl_h.back: Check calls, have the AI call someone, and manage 'To do' right from this chat. Send /help for commands.

console.n_ctl_users_h.back: In a group, specify who can give commands, otherwise nobody will be able to. In a private chat you may leave this blank. For your user ID: ask @userinfobot.

console.rc_desc.back: Enable 'Accept commands from this chat' in a notification channel above first.

console.rc_env.back: Accept commands in the Telegram chat configured via environment variables

console.rc_env_h.back: Bot and chat from TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID. TELEGRAM_CONTROL_USERS restricts who can give commands.

console.rc_errands.back: AI calls per chat per hour

console.rc_errands_h.back: 0 = no AI calls from chats. Max 30.

console.rc_msgs_h.back: Above this limit, the chat gets no further replies for the remainder of the minute.

console.mcp_title.back: Allow connection to other AI tools (MCP)

console.mcp_desc.back: Allows AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT to check your calls and 'To do'. Keep it off if you don't need it.

console.mcp_on_h.back: Works only when enabled and the Token below is set. The address is the web console's followed by /mcp.

console.mcp_tok_h.back: Enter this Token into the AI tool (as a Bearer token).

console.mcp_calls.back: Can it ask the AI to make calls?

console.mcp_c_confirm.back: Yes, but ask me in chat first

console.mcp_calls_h.back: 'Ask me first' requires a chat that accepts commands.

console.mcp_errands_h.back: All AI tools combined, from 0 to 30.

console.mcp_origins_h.back: Only for web-based AI tools: one address per line, e.g. https://app.example. Otherwise leave blank.

console.hint_telegram.back: Create a bot with @BotFather and paste its token. Chat ID: @userinfobot tells you yours; for a group, use the group ID and add the bot. Send a first message to the bot so it can message you.

console.hint_discord.back: Notifications: enter a Webhook URL (channel settings -> Integrations -> Webhooks -> New Webhook -> Copy Webhook URL) or bot token plus channel ID; one suffices. For DMs, put your ID instead of channel ID. Chat commands: enter bot token and channel ID, and enable Message Content Intent for the bot.

console.hint_slack.back: Notifications: copy an Incoming Webhook URL (Mattermost included) or enter bot token plus channel ID; one suffices. Chat commands (Slack only): enable Socket Mode, then enter bot token (xoxb-), app-level token (xapp-), and channel ID.

console.hint_line.back: LINE Developers console -> your Messaging API channel: issue a channel access token and copy your user ID (starts with U). Add the bot as a friend first. LINE Notify shut down in 2025; this replaces it.

console.hint_ntfy.back: Choose a hard-to-guess topic name and subscribe in the ntfy app. Leave server blank for ntfy.sh. Token is needed only for protected topics.

console.hint_gotify.back: In Gotify: Apps -> Create application, then copy its token. Server URL is your Gotify server's address.

console.hint_bark.back: Open Bark on your iPhone and copy the device key from the sample URL. Leave server blank to use the public one.

console.hint_pushover.back: Create an app on pushover.net to obtain the API token. Your user key is on the Pushover dashboard.

console.hint_wecom.back: In the WeCom group: add a group bot, then copy its webhook URL.

console.hint_dingtalk.back: Group settings -> Bots -> add a custom bot and copy the webhook URL. If you chose 'Sign' for security, paste the secret code (starts with SEC).

console.hint_feishu.back: Group settings -> Bots -> Add bot -> Custom bot, then copy the webhook URL. Don't enable signature verification.

console.hint_serverchan.back: Copy your SendKey from ServerChan's website.

console.hint_matrix.back: Your homeserver (e.g. https://matrix.org), a sender account access token, and the ID of a room that account has joined (starts with !).

console.hint_gmail.back: Your Gmail address and an app password (Google Account -> Security -> 2-Step Verification -> App passwords). Not your regular password.

console.hint_apprise.back: Your Apprise API server's notification URL, e.g. http://host:8000/notify/KEY. A tag restricts which services get the message.

console.hint_webhook.back: Any URL accepting a JSON POST with event, title, body, and data. Handy for n8n, Home Assistant, or custom scripts.

console.hint_teams.back: In Teams: channel ... menu -> Workflows -> 'Post to a channel when a webhook request is received', complete the steps, and copy the provided URL. Old Office 365 connectors are retired.

console.hint_googlechat.back: In Google Chat: open space -> Apps & integrations -> Webhooks -> Add webhook, then copy its URL. Requires a Google Workspace account.

console.hint_rocketchat.back: Administration -> Workspace -> Integrations -> New -> Incoming: enable it, choose the channel, and copy the webhook URL.

console.hint_zulip.back: Personal settings -> Bots -> Add a new bot (Incoming webhook or Generic) and enter email and API key as email:key. Target: channel > topic (e.g. calls > phone), or one or more emails for a direct message.

console.hint_webex.back: Create a bot on developer.webex.com and copy its access token. Add the bot to a space and enter the room ID, or a person's email.

console.hint_nextcloud.back: Your Nextcloud address, username and an app password (Settings -> Security) written as user:password, and the conversation token: the final part of the conversation link.

console.hint_synology.back: In Synology Chat: Integration -> Incoming Webhook -> Create, then copy the webhook URL. On your local network, http:// on port 5000 avoids certificate errors.

console.hint_signal.back: Requires your own signal-cli-rest-api server with a registered number. Enter server address, registered number in international format (+...), and recipients: comma-separated numbers or group IDs.

console.hint_pushbullet.back: pushbullet.com -> Settings -> Account -> Create Access Token. Leave target blank to send to all your devices, or enter a device ID or email.

console.hint_pushplus.back: Sign in at pushplus.plus and copy your token. A group code sends to that group; blank sends only to you.

console.hint_pushdeer.back: Open PushDeer, add a key, and copy it. Leave server blank to use the public one.

console.hint_wxpusher.back: Easiest: a simple push token (SPT_...) from the WxPusher site, with no target. Or your app's appToken (AT_...) with comma-separated user IDs (UID_...) or topic IDs.

console.hint_chanify.back: In Chanify, create a token for this sender and copy it. Leave server blank to use the public one.

console.hint_smtp.back: Any TLS mail server: smtp://you@example.com@smtp.example.com:587 (STARTTLS) or smtps://...:465. The login account is also the sender. Use an app password if your provider offers it.

console.hint_homeassistant.back: Your Home Assistant address, a long-lived access token (Profile -> Security), and the notification service, e.g. mobile_app_pixel_9 (under Developer tools -> Actions).

console.hint_ifttt.back: ifttt.com/maker_webhooks -> Documentation shows your key. Create an 'If Webhooks: Receive a web request' applet with the same event name; value1 is title and value2 is message.

console.f_public_url_h.back: Notification links use this address. Empty = the one shown in grey; with Docker, or to connect from away from home, enter your own.

console.g_summary_d.back: After every call, the AI writes a brief summary. Usually nothing needs setting up here.

console.f_sum_base_h.back: Any service compatible with OpenAI works, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1.

console.f_sum_provider_h.back: Uses your Gemini key by default. To use a different service, select 'Another service'.

console.f_cal_suggest_h.back: When a date is set during a call (a delivery, an appointment), the summary includes an "add to calendar" link.

console.f_appt_mode_h.back: When a caller wants to book a time, the AI doesn't accept right away; it says it'll check and let them know. Then you press Accept or Decline in "To-do" on the Calls page or in the notification.

console.f_appt_reply_h.back: Automatic: an SMS to mobiles, an AI callback to landlines. Hidden and non-callable numbers (foreign, toll-free, and similar) get no reply.

console.f_think_h.back: Only for models with 'thinking' in the name. Low replies faster.
